name: Association of Community Centre Catchment Area
description: This layer represents City Council-approved catchment areas for all Association of Community Centres (AOCCs) in the City of Toronto. Catchment areas define geographic boundaries within which each AOCC is intended to serve local residences, guiding service delivery, outreach, and planning.

sample.CATCHMENT_AREA_DESC: The Association of Community Centre, Waterfront Neighbourhood Centre is located in the southern downtown and waterfront area of the City of Toronto. The catchment area for Waterfront Neighbourhood Centre starts at the intersection of Strachan Avenue and the Canadian National Railway (C N R). The catchment area follows the C N R east to Front Street West and continues east to Yonge Street. The catchment area continues south along Yonge Street to the Toronto Shoreline. From the Toronto Shoreline the catchment area goes out and around the entire Toronto Islands area back to approximately where the Toronto shoreline and the Martin Goodman Trail and Coronation Park Trail all intersect. From the point, the catchment area continues north becoming Strachan Avenue and back to the C N R.
sample.MISSION_STATEMENT: Waterfront Neighbourhood Centre (WNC) strives to engage all community members in an atmosphere of belonging, diversity and accessibility through our programs, services and facilities. As a cornerstone of the community, WNC also advocates for the needs of this ever changing neighbourhood.

sample.CATCHMENT_AREA_DESC: The Association of Community Centre, Swansea Town Hall Community Centre is located west of the downtown area of the City of Toronto. The catchment area for Swansea Town Hall Community Centre starts at the intersection of the Humber River and Bloor Street West. The catchment area continues east along Bloor Street West to the eastern boundary of High Park, approximately where the High Park Trail begins. The catchment area continues south along the High Park Trail to approximately where it intersects with the Toronto Shoreline. The catchment area continues west along the Toronto Shoreline to where it intersects the Humber River and goes north back to Bloor Street West.
sample.MISSION_STATEMENT: Swansea Town Hall is a locally based organization that promotes community building. We promote a variety of activities and services for all ages by offering welcoming, accessible and affordable space; hosting public services and providing community programming.

sample.CATCHMENT_AREA_DESC: The Association of Community Centre, Scadding Court Community Centre is located in downtown area of the City of Toronto. The catchment area for Scadding Court Community Centre starts at the intersection of Dovercourt Road and Bloor Street West. The catchment area continues east along Bloor Street West to Yonge Street then continues south along Yonge Street to Lake Shore Boulevard West. The catchment area continues west along Lake Shote Boulevard West to where Atlantic Avenue extended intersects. The catchment area continues north along Atlantic Ave becoming Dovercourt Road and continues back to Bloor Street West.
sample.MISSION_STATEMENT: SCCC’s mandate is to support and foster the well-being of individuals, families, and community groups by providing and encouraging both local and international opportunities for recreation, education, athletics, community participation and inclusive social interaction.

sample.CATCHMENT_AREA_DESC: The Association of Community Centre, Ralph Thornton Community Centre is located east of the downtown area of the City of Toronto. The catchment area for Ralph Thornton Community Centre starts at the intersection of the Lower Don River and Danforth Avenue. The catchment area continues east along Danforth Avenue to Coxwell Avenue then goes south along Coxwell Avenue to the Toronto Shoreline. The catchment area continues west along the shoreline around the port area back to where approximately the Don River intersects. The catchment area continues north along the Don River back to Danforth Avenue.
sample.MISSION_STATEMENT: The Ralph Thornton Community Centre is a gathering place that welcomes, connects and engages the community in all its diversity.

sample.CATCHMENT_AREA_DESC: The Association of Community Centre, Cecil is located in downtown area of the City of Toronto. The catchment area for Cecil starts at the intersection of Bathurst Street and Bloor Street West. The catchment area continues east to Queen's Park Boulevard continuing south becoming University Avenue. The catchment area continues west along Queen Street West to Bathurst Street and goes north back to Bloor Street West.
sample.MISSION_STATEMENT: Our mission is to foster a sense of community and enhance the quality of life through the development, encouragement and support of programs and activities responsive to local needs.

sample.CATCHMENT_AREA_DESC: The Association of Community Centre, Applegrove is located east of the downtown area of the City of Toronto. The catchment area for Applegrove starts at the intersection of Jones Avenue and the Canadian National Railway (C N R). name: Association of Community Centre Catchment Area
description: This layer represents City Council-approved catchment areas for all Association of Community Centres (AOCCs) in the City of Toronto. Catchment areas define geographic boundaries within which each AOCC is intended to serve local residences, guiding service delivery, outreach, and planning.

sample.CATCHMENT_AREA_DESC: The Association of Community Centre, Waterfront Neighbourhood Centre is located in the southern downtown and waterfront area of the City of Toronto. The catchment area for Waterfront Neighbourhood Centre starts at the intersection of Strachan Avenue and the Canadian National Railway (C N R). The catchment area follows the C N R east to Front Street West and continues east to Yonge Street. The catchment area continues south along Yonge Street to the Toronto Shoreline. From the Toronto Shoreline the catchment area goes out and around the entire Toronto Islands area back to approximately where the Toronto shoreline and the Martin Goodman Trail and Coronation Park Trail all intersect. From the point, the catchment area continues north becoming Strachan Avenue and back to the C N R.
sample.MISSION_STATEMENT: Waterfront Neighbourhood Centre (WNC) strives to engage all community members in an atmosphere of belonging, diversity and accessibility through our programs, services and facilities. As a cornerstone of the community, WNC also advocates for the needs of this ever changing neighbourhood.

sample.CATCHMENT_AREA_DESC: The Association of Community Centre, Swansea Town Hall Community Centre is located west of the downtown area of the City of Toronto. The catchment area for Swansea Town Hall Community Centre starts at the intersection of the Humber River and Bloor Street West. The catchment area continues east along Bloor Street West to the eastern boundary of High Park, approximately where the High Park Trail begins. The catchment area continues south along the High Park Trail to approximately where it intersects with the Toronto Shoreline. The catchment area continues west along the Toronto Shoreline to where it intersects the Humber River and goes north back to Bloor Street West.
sample.MISSION_STATEMENT: Swansea Town Hall is a locally based organization that promotes community building. We promote a variety of activities and services for all ages by offering welcoming, accessible and affordable space; hosting public services and providing community programming.

sample.CATCHMENT_AREA_DESC: The Association of Community Centre, Scadding Court Community Centre is located in downtown area of the City of Toronto. The catchment area for Scadding Court Community Centre starts at the intersection of Dovercourt Road and Bloor Street West. The catchment area continues east along Bloor Street West to Yonge Street then continues south along Yonge Street to Lake Shore Boulevard West. The catchment area continues west along Lake Shote Boulevard West to where Atlantic Avenue extended intersects. The catchment area continues north along Atlantic Ave becoming Dovercourt Road and continues back to Bloor Street West.
sample.MISSION_STATEMENT: SCCC’s mandate is to support and foster the well-being of individuals, families, and community groups by providing and encouraging both local and international opportunities for recreation, education, athletics, community participation and inclusive social interaction.

sample.CATCHMENT_AREA_DESC: The Association of Community Centre, Ralph Thornton Community Centre is located east of the downtown area of the City of Toronto. The catchment area for Ralph Thornton Community Centre starts at the intersection of the Lower Don River and Danforth Avenue. The catchment area continues east along Danforth Avenue to Coxwell Avenue then goes south along Coxwell Avenue to the Toronto Shoreline. The catchment area continues west along the shoreline around the port area back to where approximately the Don River intersects. The catchment area continues north along the Don River back to Danforth Avenue.
sample.MISSION_STATEMENT: The Ralph Thornton Community Centre is a gathering place that welcomes, connects and engages the community in all its diversity.

sample.CATCHMENT_AREA_DESC: The Association of Community Centre, Cecil is located in downtown area of the City of Toronto. The catchment area for Cecil starts at the intersection of Bathurst Street and Bloor Street West. The catchment area continues east to Queen's Park Boulevard continuing south becoming University Avenue. The catchment area continues west along Queen Street West to Bathurst Street and goes north back to Bloor Street West.
sample.MISSION_STATEMENT: Our mission is to foster a sense of community and enhance the quality of life through the development, encouragement and support of programs and activities responsive to local needs.

sample.CATCHMENT_AREA_DESC: The Association of Community Centre, Applegrove is located east of the downtown area of the City of Toronto. The catchment area for Applegrove starts at the intersection of Jones Avenue and the Canadian National Railway (C N R). The catchment area goes east along the C N R to Woodbine Avenue then continues south along Woodbine Avenue to the Toronto Shoreline. The catchment area continues west along the shoreline to where the Martin Good Trail and Leslie Street meet the shoreline. The catchment area continues north along Leslie Street to Queen Street East and goes west briefly to Jones Avenue. The catchment area continues north along Jones Avenue back to the C N R.
sample.MISSION_STATEMENT: We are a multi-service agency that delivers a variety of programs and services, hosts meetings and events, supports action on local issues, partners with others, and provides volunteer and employment opportunities. Our work is about supporting individuals and families, strengthening communities and building a better Toronto

sample.CATCHMENT_AREA_DESC: The Association of Community Centre, Community Centre 55 is located east of the downtown area of the City of Toronto. The catchment area for Community Centre 55 starts at the intersection of Coxwell Avenue and Danforth Avenue. The catchment area continues east to Victoria Park Avenue then goes south along Victoria Park Avenue to the Toronto Shoreline. The catchment area continues west along the shoreline to where approximately the shoreline and Emdaabiimok Avenue intersect. The catchment area goes north becoming Coxwell Avenue and continues back to Danforth Avenue.
sample.MISSION_STATEMENT: Through programming and service excellence, we contribute to a healthier and happier community.

sample.CATCHMENT_AREA_DESC: The Association of Community Centre, 519 Church Street Community Centre (the 519) is located in downtown area of the City of Toronto.
